open_obligations.what_is_open: Prove the converse for every generated \(\operatorname{ResidualPending}\) state: a fiber-constant target must have a verifier-encoded rational projection, while a nonconstant target must have a rational-affine support-exact global-twin box.
open_obligations.obstruction: The deterministic task machine reaches residuals without circular scheduling, but finiteness of the fixed candidate generators does not imply their exhaustiveness. The frozen primitives neither exclude an identified residual having only a nonrational algebraic observable representative nor prove that a common signed response-row contrast lifts through every interacting district and observed descendant while preserving exact selector support.
open_obligations.attempted: Reused the established input determinacy, computed closure and valid fixing, local context, truncated-factorization, hybrid and Join identities, denominator induction, multiset termination, successful LGS refinement, binary residual certificate, and ordinary-ID specialization. The formula and twin implications follow from certificate soundness without inserting a successful trace, an extensional identification oracle, or unrestricted quantifier elimination into the machine.

prose_updates.tldr: For finite selector-gated semi-Markovian SCMs observed on exactly \(H\), retained support normalization and a deterministic Algorithms 1--2 task machine preserve every successful support-licensed formula, certify every actual division, and terminate at a sound formula, a verifier-accepted support-exact twin, or an explicitly pending residual. The all-residual rational-formula-or-global-twin dichotomy remains the sole missing step, so the field completeness theorem is retained as the headline but is not claimed as proved.

project_justification.gap: Lee, Ghassami, and Shpitser give a sound systematic-selection recursion and witnesses for specified failures, but not an input-determined fixed-support execution semantics or an all-residual exact-support converse. The redesigned machine closes the execution gap without importing a successful trace; exhaustiveness of the fixed residual generators is the sole remaining mathematical gap.
project_justification.niche: The setting fixes one coherent joint selector law on exactly \(H\). Supported contexts share natural mechanisms and selector provenance, while absent contexts cannot be invoked. This differs from ordinary observational ID and from data-fusion formulations that supply separate experiments.
project_justification.fill: The proved layer supplies intrinsic support normalization, canonical finite graph computations, explicit recursive work tasks, computed valid fixing sequences, distinct truncated factorization and fixing, a step-indexed positivity ledger, multiset termination, preservation of every successful support-licensed positive branch, sound formula and twin verification, pointwise interior inference, and an ordinary-ID structural specialization. The intended field result additionally requires the open all-residual rational-projection-or-global-contrast theorem.

sampling_model.design: Units are sampled independently from the single joint law \(p_H(V,S)\), whose selector support is exactly the declared finite set \(H\); the machine never constructs a context outside that set.
sampling_model.units: Observed units are i.i.d. draws of \((V,S)\); latent roots and response types are not observed.
sampling_model.treatment: The observed treatment components may be natural or selector-overridden according to the known gate encoded by \(S\); the target sets \(A=a\) and \(S=s_{\emptyset}\).
sampling_model.overlap: Every structurally admissible supported cell is strictly positive. Each context normalizer, chain-rule conditioning marginal, actual nested-fixing conditional, and accepted elimination divisor used by a returned formula is recorded in a step-indexed ledger and proved positive by induction. No common numerical lower bound and no positivity outside \(H\) are imposed.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: On a formula branch, estimate the finite table \(p_H\) empirically and evaluate the returned rational circuit only on its ledger-projected domain \(\mathfrak D_H\). Pointwise Wald inference is valid at each fixed differentiable interior law with positive target variance. A pending residual is an algorithmic certificate gap, not a point estimate or a nonidentification conclusion.

prose_updates.related_work: Lee, Ghassami, and Shpitser (2024) provide the selector-gated model and Algorithms 1--2. The present positive result is a line-by-line, input-determined refinement: every graph, context, closure, fixing sequence, hybrid factor, and denominator is computed from the finite input and current state, and every successful support-licensed branch is preserved. Shpitser and Pearl (2006) provide the ordinary ID formula-or-hedge endpoint; the new machine specializes structurally to that recursion when the selector is constant and separated. Tabell, Tikka, and Karvanen (2026) give pruning and clustering for general data fusion but no fixed-support parameter-image converse. The remaining novelty claim is confined to exact-support residual exhaustion, which is still open.
prose_updates.interpretation: A positive output is an explicit rational map of the supplied joint selector table, together with every denominator needed to evaluate it. A verifier-accepted negative output is an open rational family of canonical SCM pairs sharing the entire admissible observed law and exact selector support while disagreeing on the intervention target. An LGS failure tag or \(\operatorname{ResidualPending}\) output carries neither conclusion by itself.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: Nonresidual circularity is removed: initialization, closure, contexts, conditional-independence tests, fixing orders, hybrid products, spawned district work, and denominator proofs are finite deterministic computations. The unresolved issue is semantic rather than operational: it is unknown whether every generated residual has a rational identifying projection or a common rational-affine response contrast preserving all supported observed descendants. Boundary-uniform inference and unrestricted quantifier elimination remain outside scope.
prose_updates.honest_scope: Proved here are support normalization, input determinacy, computed closure and fixing, local context and kernel identities, step-indexed denominator positivity, no-stuck nonresidual progress, multiset termination, preservation of successful published positive formulas, certificate soundness, the binary Algorithm-2 residual certificate, pointwise interior Wald inference, and ordinary-ID structural reduction. The formula-or-global-twin completeness theorem remains open exactly through \(\textnormal{oeq:all-residual-dichotomy}\); no LGS failure tag is promoted to nonidentification without a verified global twin, and no absent selector context is supplied.

statement_notes.justification: This remains the field headline: completing it would turn every pending residual into either an explicit identifying circuit or an exact-support global-twin box.
statement_notes.gap: All nonresidual execution obligations and both certificate-soundness directions are closed; the sole remaining gap is exhaustive rational projection or common response-contrast compilation for every residual, including exclusion of nonrational-only identified fibers.
statement_notes.consumer: The backend may expose Formula and verifier-accepted Twin results now, but must label every other endpoint ResidualPending until the residual dichotomy is proved.
